decisions.reason: Having survived its first review and fitting tightly with the core platform and data capabilities, this extension likely remains at or above aspiration and is worth continuing.
As a close-to-core gas-tariff comparison tool, it is still more likely to be retained while management exploits existing know-how and customer relationships than to be withdrawn quickly.
This electricity tariff calculator matches the firm’s established customer problems and platform direction, so continued use and incremental learning make retention more likely than exit.
Because this product line is less prominently marketed and has several models, it faces more portfolio-rationalisation risk, but its overlap with core capabilities still favors keeping it for now.
The area-definition tool complements surrounding tariff and process solutions, so even with uncertain standalone demand the firm is likely to keep it as a supporting module.
